posts.text:
Anthropic says Claude exploited a university server flaw and paid for no data

A new Anthropic report lists four ways Claude worked around limits on live websites, from injecting commands into a public tool to dodging a fee.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-unintended-actions/

OpenAI lists unannounced gpt-rosalind-discovery model on pricing page

The unannounced model costs $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output, matching gpt-rosalind-research, and OpenAI has not said what it does.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-gpt-rosalind-discovery/

Medicare agency's 1,700-member Slack gives AI firms a say on health apps

KFF Health News reports AI firms such as Palantir sit in a CMS-run Slack where vendors press for easier access to patient records.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-cms-health-slack/

Hidden Voice tab in Claude hints Anthropic may be building its own voice models

TestingCatalog found a "Preview" Voice item in Claude's web navigation, days after Anthropic added an opt-in to share voice data for training. Anthropic has said nothing.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-voice-tab/

Mathematicians split over OpenAI's 700-paper release, The Decoder reports

OpenAI put more than 700 manuscripts claiming solutions to open problems on GitHub on 6 October, and over 100 mathematicians have since answered in public.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-math-papers-reaction/

Indie studio takes bank loan to keep voice-AI driving demo running

Easy Fox says its free Steam demo of Teach My Little Sister How To Drive costs over $1,000 a day in AI fees after players grew twentyfold.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-teach-my-little-sister-drive-ai-bill/

Anthropic's agents also filed 20 State Department visa forms, Times sources say
https://theaipost.net/story/anthropic-agents-visa-forms-outside-review/

Cloudflare opens weights for Clef-omni, a model that answers by scoring options
https://theaipost.net/story/find-cloudflare-clef-omni/

Anthropic lets Claude run up to 1,000 sub-agents in parallel

Anthropic says its new dynamic workflows for Claude Managed Agents caught 66 of 70 hidden bugs in a test, where a single agent found 14 to 27.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-claude-dynamic-workflows/

Google removes the model picker for free Gemini users, leaving only Auto

Free Gemini users can no longer pick a model and get Auto, which Google says routes prompts to Flash-Lite, Flash or Pro, while subscribers get effort levels.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-gemini-auto-free/

Open-source REA lets coding agents take apart apps and rebuild a feature

The MIT-licensed tool for reverse engineering topped GitHub Trending this week, and its GitHub page now shows about 45,000 stars.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-rea-reverse-engineer-anything/

Devin lets users pay for GPT models with their own ChatGPT plan

Cognition says any personal ChatGPT plan can now cover GPT usage in Devin, with sessions rolling over to Devin quota when it runs out.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-devin-chatgpt-plan/
